title: ModelSpec feedback
description: POST this to https://api.modelspec.dev/v1/feedback. No key. One rating from a fixed set, optionally tied to the decision_id of a ModelSpec answer. Never include a prompt, a key, or anything that identifies a person. Reference: https://github.com/turbobeest/modelspec/blob/main/docs/feedback-api.md

rating.description: What you thought of the answer or the page.

client.description: What is sending it: an agent, the CLI, the MCP server, or the website.

decision_id.description: The decision_id of the answer this is about.

note.description: Optional. What was wrong or right, in your words.

trying_to_decide.description: Optional. What you were trying to decide.

page.description: Optional. The site path, such as /decide/.

template.description: Optional. The decision template in use.

examples.note: The top pick has no pricing for my region.
